chapter_seo_title: The Dossier of North Wind - Li Huowang's Hunt for the Zuowandao Begins
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang digs through the Supervisory Heavenly Office's archives and finally learns the terrifying truth about North Wind of the Four Joys — body-swapping, deception, and a power that can reach inside his hallucinations.
og_title: The Dossier of North Wind — Li Huowang Faces the True Scale of His Enemy
og_description: He came looking for a lead. He found a nightmare. North Wind of the Zuowandao can swap bodies at a glance and turn strangers into followers in under an hour.
twitter_description: Li Huowang's hunt for North Wind reveals the true power of the Zuowandao's Four Joys — body-swapping, instant conversion, and a reach that extends into hallucinations.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the Four Joys and Three Yuans, the highest-ranked members of the Zuowandao; named after winning hands in Chinese domino tiles, with North Wind being one of them.
Alongside the Four Joys, the apex of the Zuowandao hierarchy; named after the top three passing scores in the imperial examination.
A member of the Zuowandao's Four Joys; capable of instant Bewilderment, body-swapping, and converting normal people into accomplices through deception alone.
A rare human constitution with reality-warping properties; highly valued as an alchemical ingredient and targeted by both the Zuowandao and the Office.
A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; their power is both bureaucratic and supernatural, often wielded through a deceptively genial demeanor.
A rank above Chief Recorder in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; one was killed during the North Wind incident in Tanyang County.
A rank within the Zuowandao hierarchy, below the Four Joys and Three Yuans; a seventeen-year-old girl was converted into one by North Wind in under an hour.
